research_digest_pdf.handling: not cited; integration uses current public research baseline plus completed depth dossiers

evidence_policy.stable_fact: May be shown without same-day revalidation when the underlying fact is historical or structural.
evidence_policy.snapshot: Must display or inherit a refresh date and must not be presented as a future guarantee.
evidence_policy.dynamic: Must be refreshed T-1 or same day from an authoritative/current operational source.
prohibited_inference: invented visitor age or trip-purpose percentages
treating a bus stop as a railway station or scenic gate
treating historical gate rules as permanently valid
promising timetable availability from a public schedule snapshot

hydraulic_system.title: 三大水利核心
hydraulic_system.concept_note: 工程解释顺序与当天游客实际步行顺序可以不同；地图与路线必须分别维护 conceptual order 和 circulation order。

short_explainer.role: 分流岷江，理解因势利导
控制进入成都平原灌区的水量

budget.rule: Protect core admission, reliable return, one seated meal, water/rest and contingency before optional paid extras.

schemes.title: 平衡经典
schemes.subtitle: 第一次来最稳
cut_rules: If Anlan Bridge queue is long, skip it.
If scenic core runs late, shorten old-city wandering rather than rail buffer.
If waiting for full darkness threatens return buffer, leave Nanqiao earlier.

schemes.title: 历史文化深度
schemes.subtitle: 把工程真正看懂
schemes.dynamic_gate_rule: Qinyan/upper entry must be verified T-1 or same day; otherwise use fallback sequence.
cut_rules: If upper entry is not verified, do not invent Gate 6 access.
If rain makes hillside surfaces unattractive, remove Qinyan/Erwang climb.
If fatigue rises, preserve hydraulic core before hill nodes.

schemes.title: 美食 + 灌县古城
schemes.subtitle: 水利核心之后看活的城市
schemes.merchant_rule: A named merchant is never a single point of failure; refresh operation and replace within the same area if closed or queued.
cut_rules: Skip a snack if queue or sell-out would delay the core day.
Keep only one formal seated meal.
Do not equate tourist retail density with cultural authenticity.

schemes.title: 舒适低赶路
schemes.subtitle: 少一点是设计，不是缺失
schemes.rest_policy: Use seated meal and at least one quiet recovery block; a 15k-step figure is a ceiling-like planning reference, never a quota.
cut_rules: At moderate fatigue, sit 10-20 minutes before deciding the next node.
Delete bridge, climbs and repeat photo points before core hydraulic nodes.
Prefer an earlier comfortable train over designing around the last possible return.

schemes.title: 天气 / 拥堵韧性
schemes.subtitle: 现场能改才是真的计划
schemes.return_strategy: Keep both Lidui Park and Dujiangyan station options open until final ticket/road check.
cut_rules: Official closure, thunderstorm, heavy-rain, flash-flood or geohazard notice overrides itinerary completeness.
Skip bridge/hillside branches when surfaces, crowd or fatigue make them unattractive.
Move seated meal/rest earlier when weather or crowd pressure rises.
Skip Nanqiao and return if the evening branch weakens return control.

spot_cards.caveat: Do not confuse with same-name bus stops; target-date timetable required.
Longer road transfer from central cluster; compare live ETA plus station buffer.
Current evidence is strong, but entry/exit rules remain date-specific.
Exact route/pin and internal access are scheme-level operational facts.
Interpret as part of one hydraulic system.
Conceptual upstream order must not be confused with visitor circulation order.
Queue, weather and temporary management can make it skippable.
Adds climb/elevation; not a default low-rush node.
Qinyan Tower is stable; Gate 6 everyday entry is not verified.
Commercial convenience should not be presented as proof of authenticity.
Do not promise exact blue-light appearance or fixed lighting result.

evidence_cards.title: 游客评论审计
evidence_cards.key_boundary: Recurring themes are qualitative; no population percentages.

evidence_cards.title: 游客画像审计
evidence_cards.key_boundary: Exact 2026 age and trip-purpose shares are not publicly verified.

evidence_cards.title: 季节性审计
evidence_cards.key_boundary: Holiday peak risk is verified; normal September weekend multiplier is not.

evidence_cards.title: POI / 入口审计
evidence_cards.key_boundary: Gate and access status are dynamic; bus-stop category traps are prohibited.
